description: This file implements a cyclic buffer class for inter-process communication, including methods for reading, writing, reserving space, locking, unlocking, and managing buffer state. It interacts with system-specific synchronization primitives and manages a shared memory buffer with control structures.

classes.name: CyclicBuffer
classes.description: A class implementing a thread-safe, shared-memory cyclic buffer with locking, reading, writing, and reservation capabilities for inter-process communication.

methods.name: Validate
methods.description: Checks if the buffer's control structure is loaded and valid, loading it if necessary.

methods.name: AdminLock
methods.description: Acquires the internal mutex for thread-safe access to buffer administration.

methods.name: SignalLock
methods.description: Waits for a signal with a specified timeout, used in locking mechanisms.

methods.name: AdminUnlock
methods.description: Releases the internal mutex for buffer administration.

methods.name: DataAvailable
methods.description: Virtual method called when data becomes available; can be overridden.

methods.name: Reevaluate
methods.description: Reevaluates the buffer state and signals waiting agents if necessary.

methods.name: Alert
methods.description: Sets an alert flag and reevaluates the buffer state, notifying waiting agents.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Reads data from the buffer into a provided buffer, with support for partial reads.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Writes data into the buffer from a provided buffer, handling wrap-around and synchronization.

methods.name: AssureFreeSpace
methods.description: Ensures there is enough free space in the buffer for a write operation, expanding the tail if necessary.

methods.name: Reserve
methods.description: Reserves space in the buffer for a future write, preventing other writers from overwriting reserved space.

methods.name: Lock
methods.description: Locks the buffer for exclusive access, optionally waiting for data to be present.

methods.name: Unlock
methods.description: Releases the lock on the buffer.

methods.name: Peek
methods.description: Provides a non-destructive read of data from the buffer.

methods.name: GetOverwriteSize
methods.description: Returns the size of data that can be overwritten, virtual for customization.

methods.name: GetReadSize
methods.description: Returns the size of data available for reading, virtual for customization.
